title: 歐洲列車控制系統整合~European Train Control System integration
focus: 歐洲列控版本介面與車地相容驗證~European train-control version interfaces and train–track compatibility
summary: 本課聚焦歐洲列控版本介面與車地相容驗證。從列控制動模型輸入建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把車地資料交接與介面失配頂事件連成可驗證的介面，最後以互通試驗推論範圍整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。~This course studies european train-control version interfaces and train–track compatibility. Start with train-control braking-model inputs to define physical or information boundaries, connect train–track data handoff with top event for interface mismatch as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through scope of interoperability inference. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
history: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：2002 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法早期版發布。；2023 年歐盟列控技術規則二零二三號一六九五發布。；2025 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法第一分冊發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對歐洲列控版本介面與車地相容驗證而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用應答器位置與時效及跨版本回歸測試連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。~The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 2002: An early railway RAMS specification was published. 2023: European Commission Regulation twenty-twenty-three slash sixteen-ninety-five was adopted. 2025: A new first part of railway RAMS was published. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For european train-control version interfaces and train–track compatibility, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through balise position and data freshness and cross-version regression testing. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
example: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究列控制動模型輸入。原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。公式 y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a)，代入得 y=280 m。邊界：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。敏感度只改 v=20 至 22 m/s，輸出變為 335.5 m；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究應答器位置與時效：原創假想教學輸入：列車速度 v=18 m/s；資料年齡 t=0.25 s；定位誤差界 e=0.6 m。公式 y=v*t+e，代入得 y=5.1 m。邊界：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元以簡化制動距離理解速度、反應時間與減速度的角色，避免將教材算例當成列控制動曲線。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。~Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate train-control braking-model inputs. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s. Formula y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a) gives y=280 m. Boundary: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded. For sensitivity, change only v=20 to 22 m/s; the output becomes 335.5 m. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate balise position and data freshness: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train speed v=18 m/s; data age t=0.25 s; position error bound e=0.6 m. Formula y=v*t+e gives y=5.1 m. Boundary: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Use simplified stopping distance to understand speed, response and deceleration, without treating a teaching calculation as an operational ETCS braking curve. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.

units.anchor: 列控制動模型輸入~Train-control braking-model inputs
units.title: 列控制動模型輸入~Train-control braking-model inputs
units.mechanism: 本單元以簡化制動距離理解速度、反應時間與減速度的角色，避免將教材算例當成列控制動曲線。停止距離由反應期間的等速前進與制動期間的動能消散相加。速度增加會同時增加兩項，而減速度只影響第二項；把控制命令發出時間當成制動力建立時間會漏掉一段距離。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。~Use simplified stopping distance to understand speed, response and deceleration, without treating a teaching calculation as an operational ETCS braking curve. Stopping distance combines constant-speed travel during response with kinetic-energy removal during braking. Speed changes both contributions, whereas deceleration changes only the second. A command timestamp is not the instant at which the full braking force becomes available. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。公式 y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a)，代入得 y=280 m。邊界：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s. Formula y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a) gives y=280 m. Boundary: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded.
units.verify: 以同一時基記錄速度、制動命令與加速度，分別積分反應段及減速段，再與實際位移比較。以「列控制動模型輸入」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Record speed, brake command and acceleration on one clock, integrate response and deceleration separately, and compare their sum with measured displacement. For train-control braking-model inputs, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 減速度偏低與反應延遲都會使停車超出目標，但速度曲線的起始轉折可以區分兩種原因。回到「列控制動模型輸入」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Weak deceleration and delayed response both cause an overrun, but the onset of the speed-curve change distinguishes these causes. Trace the input chain for train-control braking-model inputs. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 速度提高一成時停止距離也必定只增加一成~Increasing speed by ten percent always increases stopping distance by exactly ten percent.
units.practice: 只把初速 v 從 20 改成 22 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 280 變為 335.5 m。先說明「列控制動模型輸入」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only initial speed v from 20 to 22 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 280 to 335.5 m. Explain the causal direction for train-control braking-model inputs, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 應答器位置與時效~Balise position and data freshness
units.title: 應答器位置與時效~Balise position and data freshness
units.mechanism: 本單元區分地標參考點的定位誤差與車載處理時間，追蹤資料從讀取到採用的整個路徑。位置資料的數值誤差與資料變舊造成的位移應分開處理。即使感測器本身準確，封包等待與處理延遲仍會擴大當前位置的不確定範圍；接收時間不能取代量測時間，否則不同子系統可能各自認為資料是新的。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。~Separate reference-point uncertainty from onboard processing time, tracing the complete path from landmark reading to use in the train-control calculation. Position measurement error and displacement accumulated while data ages are separate contributions. Even an accurate sensor can yield an uncertain current location after queuing and processing delays. Reception time cannot substitute for measurement time because subsystems could then each mistakenly regard stale information as new. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：列車速度 v=18 m/s；資料年齡 t=0.25 s；定位誤差界 e=0.6 m。公式 y=v*t+e，代入得 y=5.1 m。邊界：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train speed v=18 m/s; data age t=0.25 s; position error bound e=0.6 m. Formula y=v*t+e gives y=5.1 m. Boundary: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors.
units.verify: 保留量測、傳送及接收三個時間戳，以延遲注入重播檢查界限是否包住真值。以「應答器位置與時效」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Preserve measurement, transmit and receive timestamps; replay injected delays and verify that the resulting bound encloses the reference position. For balise position and data freshness, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 時鐘偏移會偽裝成網路延遲，重設時間戳又可能隱藏陳舊資料，需用獨立時間基準辨認。回到「應答器位置與時效」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Clock offset can imitate network delay, while timestamp replacement can conceal stale data; an independent time reference distinguishes them. Trace the input chain for balise position and data freshness. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 封包剛收到就代表其中位置一定是現在的位置~A newly received packet always contains the present position.
units.practice: 只把資料年齡 t 從 0.25 改成 0.275 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 5.1 變為 5.55 m。先說明「應答器位置與時效」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only data age t from 0.25 to 0.275 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 5.1 to 5.55 m. Explain the causal direction for balise position and data freshness, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 應答器間里程漂移~Odometry drift between balises
units.title: 應答器間里程漂移~Odometry drift between balises
units.mechanism: 本單元比較兩個地標之間的距離累積誤差，將輪徑比例偏差與單次地標校正偏移分開。輪徑與脈衝換算比例的誤差會隨行走距離累積，固定零點偏差則不隨距離放大。輪滑與空轉使輪周距離不等於地面位移；定期地標校正能約束累積誤差，但地標本身的位置與辨識可信度仍須驗證。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定比例誤差與固定偏移，未包含時變輪滑或輪徑磨耗歷程。~Compare distance accumulation between landmarks, separating wheel-scale bias from the one-time offset introduced by a landmark correction. Wheel diameter and pulse-scale error accumulate with distance, whereas a fixed zero offset does not grow. Slip makes wheel travel differ from ground displacement. Landmark updates can constrain drift, but the landmark position and identification credibility still require verification. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant scale error plus fixed offset; variable slip and wheel-wear history are not modelled.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=1500 m；比例誤差 scale=0.004 1；固定偏差 bias=0.2 m。公式 y=distance*scale+bias，代入得 y=6.2 m。邊界：固定比例誤差與固定偏移，未包含時變輪滑或輪徑磨耗歷程。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: travelled distance distance=1500 m; scale error scale=0.004 1; fixed offset bias=0.2 m. Formula y=distance*scale+bias gives y=6.2 m. Boundary: Constant scale error plus fixed offset; variable slip and wheel-wear history are not modelled.
units.verify: 在多個已知距離區段繪製殘差對距離，利用斜率與截距分別估計比例及零點。以「應答器間里程漂移」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Plot residual against several known travel distances and use slope and intercept to separate scale and zero-offset effects. For odometry drift between balises, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 一次短距離校正可能掩蓋比例誤差，輪滑事件則在殘差曲線留下突跳而非固定斜率。回到「應答器間里程漂移」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~A short calibration run can hide scale error; slip events cause residual jumps rather than a constant slope. Trace the input chain for odometry drift between balises. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 短距離校正準確就能保證長距離里程也完全準確~Accurate short-distance calibration guarantees perfectly accurate long-distance odometry.
units.practice: 只把行走距離 distance 從 1500 改成 1650 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 6.2 變為 6.8 m。先說明「應答器間里程漂移」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only travelled distance distance from 1500 to 1650 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 6.2 to 6.8 m. Explain the causal direction for odometry drift between balises, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 車地資料交接~Train–track data handoff
units.title: 車地資料交接~Train–track data handoff
units.mechanism: 本單元為讀取、驗證、轉換與採用定義一致起訖，確保各供應商的介面延遲不會漏算。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。改善最快的一段通常影響有限，且平均延遲不能代表最壞尾端；定義一致的起訖事件，才能避免子系統都量到好看的數值卻漏掉交接等待。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。~Define consistent start and finish events for reading, validation, conversion and use so interface latency between suppliers is not omitted. End-to-end delay spans sensing, communication, computation and actuation. Improving the fastest stage often yields little benefit, and mean latency does not represent its worst tail. Consistent start and end events prevent subsystems from reporting attractive numbers while overlooking handoff queues. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。公式 y=sense+network+compute+actuate，代入得 y=0.25 s。邊界：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s. Formula y=sense+network+compute+actuate gives y=0.25 s. Boundary: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails.
units.verify: 沿同一事件編號串接時間戳，檢查每一段邊界是否重疊或漏算，並注入負載重測。以「車地資料交接」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Follow one event identifier through timestamps, check stage boundaries for overlap or gaps, and repeat under injected load. For train–track data handoff, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 時間基準不同可造成負延遲假象；漏記排隊會使快速單元測試無法預測整合表現。回到「車地資料交接」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Different clock references can create apparently negative delays; omitted queues prevent fast unit tests from predicting integrated performance. Trace the input chain for train–track data handoff. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短~Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.
units.practice: 只把網路時間 network 從 0.08 改成 0.088 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.25 變為 0.258 s。先說明「車地資料交接」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only network time network from 0.08 to 0.088 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.25 to 0.258 s. Explain the causal direction for train–track data handoff, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 模式轉換可達性~Reachability of mode transitions
units.title: 模式轉換可達性~Reachability of mode transitions
units.mechanism: 本單元在抽象狀態機中檢查合法轉換與拒絕轉換，不把版本名稱相同當作所有行為相容的證據。布林狀態組合隨變數個數指數成長，這說明逐一人工檢查很快失去效率。可達性約束能排除不可能組合，但刪除條件必須有證據；安全性質通常針對所有可達狀態，而非幾個畫面上看起來合理的狀態。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。~Check allowed and rejected transitions in an abstract state machine, without treating a shared version name as proof that every behaviour is compatible. Boolean combinations grow exponentially with variable count, explaining why manual enumeration soon becomes ineffective. Reachability constraints can eliminate impossible combinations, but each exclusion needs justification. Safety properties normally concern every reachable state rather than a few states that look plausible on a display. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：布林變數數量 bits=8 bits。公式 y=2**bits，代入得 y=256 states。邊界：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: number of Boolean state variables bits=8 bits. Formula y=2**bits gives y=256 states. Boundary: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately.
units.verify: 用小型模型列舉轉移，再與需求允許的轉移表比較，對被排除狀態留下理由。以「模式轉換可達性」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Enumerate transitions in a small model, compare against the required transition table, and document reasons for excluded states. For reachability of mode transitions, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 把感測器故障狀態預先刪掉會讓證明失去關鍵邊界，狀態抽象過粗也可能隱藏時序競爭。回到「模式轉換可達性」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Excluding sensor-fault states can remove the crucial boundary from a proof; overly coarse abstraction may hide timing races. Trace the input chain for reachability of mode transitions. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合~Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
units.practice: 只把布林變數數量 bits 從 8 改成 9 bits（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 256 變為 512 states。先說明「模式轉換可達性」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only number of Boolean state variables bits from 8 to 9 bits (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 256 to 512 states. Explain the causal direction for reachability of mode transitions, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 版本相容需求矩陣~Version-compatibility requirement matrix
units.title: 版本相容需求矩陣~Version-compatibility requirement matrix
units.mechanism: 本單元把車載版本、地面版本與功能需求分別列出，避免只測一種搭配就推論全網互通。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~List onboard version, trackside version and functional requirements separately, avoiding network-wide interoperability claims from testing one combination. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
units.verify: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。以「版本相容需求矩陣」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence. For version-compatibility requirement matrix, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「版本相容需求矩陣」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for version-compatibility requirement matrix. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險~One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
units.practice: 只把已執行案例 tested 從 72 改成 73 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.8 變為 0.811111 1。先說明「版本相容需求矩陣」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only executed cases tested from 72 to 73 cases (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.8 to 0.811111 1. Explain the causal direction for version-compatibility requirement matrix, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 介面失配頂事件~Top event for interface mismatch
units.title: 介面失配頂事件~Top event for interface mismatch
units.mechanism: 本單元把資料語意與設定檔錯配作為不同候選原因，先建立失效邏輯再討論假想機率。只要任一支路失效就產生頂事件時，需計算聯集而不是把兩機率相乘。獨立假設允許扣掉交集的乘積，若共享電源、環境或軟體則交集另有結構；事件樹和失效樹必須保持同一任務時間。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：兩事件獨立且機率屬同一任務期間，並非每小時危險失效率。~Treat semantic mismatch and configuration mismatch as distinct candidate causes, defining fault logic before assigning hypothetical probabilities. When either branch can trigger the top event, the relevant probability is a union rather than a product. Independence permits the intersection to be written as a product; shared power, environment or software changes that intersection. Event and fault trees must use the same mission duration. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Two independent events over one mission interval, not a dangerous-failure rate per hour.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：事件一機率 p1=0.001 1；事件二機率 p2=0.002 1。公式 y=p1+p2-p1*p2，代入得 y=0.002998 1。邊界：兩事件獨立且機率屬同一任務期間，並非每小時危險失效率。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: event one probability p1=0.001 1; event two probability p2=0.002 1. Formula y=p1+p2-p1*p2 gives y=0.002998 1. Boundary: Two independent events over one mission interval, not a dangerous-failure rate per hour.
units.verify: 先畫頂事件邏輯再代機率，明列共享資源並檢查事件時間窗是否一致。以「介面失配頂事件」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Draw top-event logic before inserting probabilities, list shared resources, and check consistent time windows. For top event for interface mismatch, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 把聯集誤寫成交集會低估危險；混合年度機率與每小時機率則使結果失去量綱意義。回到「介面失配頂事件」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Confusing a union with an intersection understates risk; mixing annual and hourly probabilities destroys the intended meaning. Trace the input chain for top event for interface mismatch. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 任一支路故障即失效時總機率等於兩機率相乘~If either branch failure is sufficient, total failure probability equals their product.
units.practice: 只把事件一機率 p1 從 0.001 改成 0.0011 1（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.002998 變為 0.0030978 1。先說明「介面失配頂事件」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only event one probability p1 from 0.001 to 0.0011 1 (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.002998 to 0.0030978 1. Explain the causal direction for top event for interface mismatch, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 測試記錄時間對齊~Aligning integration-test clocks
units.title: 測試記錄時間對齊~Aligning integration-test clocks
units.mechanism: 本單元比較車載、地面和測試儀紀錄的時間差，避免把儀器時基誤差當成系統反應延遲。時鐘頻率偏差會隨時間累積成時間差，校時瞬間的偏移與之不同。多系統事件排序若依不同時鐘，可能把因果順序顛倒；校時跳變又會使量測區間長度失真，所以需記錄時鐘品質與校正事件。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。~Compare timestamps from onboard equipment, wayside equipment and test instruments, avoiding confusion between reference-clock error and system response delay. Clock frequency error accumulates into time offset and differs from initial synchronization offset. Ordering multisystem events on different clocks can reverse apparent causality. Synchronization jumps can distort interval lengths, so clock quality and correction events must be recorded. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。公式 y=drift*1e-6*duration，代入得 y=0.072 s。邊界：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s. Formula y=drift*1e-6*duration gives y=0.072 s. Boundary: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted.
units.verify: 用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。以「測試記錄時間對齊」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump. For aligning integration-test clocks, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。回到「測試記錄時間對齊」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay. Trace the input chain for aligning integration-test clocks. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致~Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day.
units.practice: 只把未校時期間 duration 從 3600 改成 3960 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.072 變為 0.0792 s。先說明「測試記錄時間對齊」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only unsynchronized interval duration from 3600 to 3960 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.072 to 0.0792 s. Explain the causal direction for aligning integration-test clocks, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 跨版本回歸測試~Cross-version regression testing
units.title: 跨版本回歸測試~Cross-version regression testing
units.mechanism: 本單元為每種版本組合保留環境還原與資料核對時間，明確追蹤變更後哪些證據需要重新取得。測試工時包含案例執行與環境設定、資料復原及證據整理。平行化只有在資源和狀態真正獨立時有效；把多個會修改同一狀態的測試同時執行，可能造成結果不可重現，表面節省時間卻增加診斷成本。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。~Budget restoration and data checks for every version combination, explicitly tracking which evidence must be regenerated after a change. Test effort includes case execution, setup, state restoration and evidence handling. Parallelism helps only when resources and state are genuinely independent. Concurrent tests modifying one shared state can become irreproducible, apparently saving execution time while increasing diagnostic cost. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：測試案例數 cases=120 cases；平均案例時間 minutes=8 min/case；設定與恢復時間 setup=180 min。公式 y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60，代入得 y=19 h。邊界：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: test cases cases=120 cases; mean case duration minutes=8 min/case; setup and recovery time setup=180 min. Formula y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60 gives y=19 h. Boundary: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded.
units.verify: 逐案記錄前置狀態、執行時間與復原時間，分開列出正常完成和失敗重測。以「跨版本回歸測試」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Record preconditions, execution and restoration for every case, separating normal completion from failure reruns. For cross-version regression testing, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。回到「跨版本回歸測試」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. Trace the input chain for cross-version regression testing. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果~All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results.
units.practice: 只把測試案例數 cases 從 120 改成 121 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 19 變為 19.1333 h。先說明「跨版本回歸測試」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only test cases cases from 120 to 121 cases (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 19 to 19.1333 h. Explain the causal direction for cross-version regression testing, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 互通試驗推論範圍~Scope of interoperability inference
units.title: 互通試驗推論範圍~Scope of interoperability inference
units.mechanism: 本單元把成功試驗限制在已測功能與版本集合，說明零失敗紀錄不能外推到未測國別或設備。零次觀察到失效不代表真實失效機率為零。獨立伯努利試驗可由全數成功的機率反推單側上界，試驗數增加才會縮小界限；相關測試或只選容易案例會使這個統計推論不再成立，也不能由此宣告達到安全完整性等級。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。~Limit successful-test inference to the tested function and version set, explaining why a zero-failure record does not cover untested national or equipment variants. Zero observed failures does not imply zero true failure probability. Independent Bernoulli trials allow a one-sided upper bound from the probability of all successes, which decreases with sample count. Correlated or selectively easy cases invalidate this inference and cannot establish a safety-integrity level. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。公式 y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests)，代入得 y=0.00993608 failure probability。邊界：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1. Formula y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests) gives y=0.00993608 failure probability. Boundary: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.
units.verify: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「互通試驗推論範圍」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. For scope of interoperability inference, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。回到「互通試驗推論範圍」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Trace the input chain for scope of interoperability inference. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零~Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
units.practice: 只把獨立試驗次數 tests 從 300 改成 301 independent trials（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.00993608 變為 0.00990324 failure probability。先說明「互通試驗推論範圍」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only independent trial count tests from 300 to 301 independent trials (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.00993608 to 0.00990324 failure probability. Explain the causal direction for scope of interoperability inference, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
